title: Red Dead Redemption 2
summary: Red Dead Online never connects to its servers on a Mac: its TCP connections have to be made without TCP options. This switches on NotProton's Red Dead Online fix row for the game, whose library does that for this game alone. Quit Steam before installing. NotProton with CrossOver Preview 41303 (Rosetta) only; not yet played with the row.

credits.name: NotProton's creator
credits.note: Found that Red Dead Online needs its TCP connections made without TCP options and wrote the fix: first for wineserver (engine patch 0037 set it from ntdll), then as the NotProton plugin tcp-noopt.dylib, which MacGameFix carries and this fix switches on.

excerpts.note: The fix is NOTPROTON_TCP_NOOPT=1 in the game's launch options; it needs NotProton's Red Dead Online fix row and the library it names.

symptom: Red Dead Online never connects to its servers; the story mode plays.
cause: Its TCP connections to Rockstar's servers have to be made without TCP options, which macOS sends by default (MSS, window scale, SACK, timestamps).
fix: NotProton's Red Dead Online fix row, whose library tcp-noopt.dylib (NotProton's creator's, carried by MacGameFix) sets macOS's TCP_NOOPT on the game's sockets before they connect, from outside ntdll. This fix switches the row on for the game with NOTPROTON_TCP_NOOPT=1 in its launch options. Without window scaling a connection keeps at most 64 KB in flight, so it is only for this game. Played on 2026-11-20 with engine patch 0037, which did the same inside ntdll.so: Red Dead Online, which never connected on that Mac, reached its online world. The row's library was checked on 2026-11-26 on NotProton's 41303 runner with NotProton's ntdll.so; not yet played with it.
backend: Any: the fix is in the network, not the graphics.
crossover: CrossOver Preview 27 (27.0.0.41303), NotProton runner on Rosetta, 2026-11-20 (0037); row checked 2026-11-26
